text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
They called it the Derby with the greatest
racers of all time.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Among such amazing runners, no one
thought of her as special.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: But she knew who she was.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
To leave her past defeats behind, she
unleashed all her being into
the final sprint
and, in a burst of blinding light, stood
victorious at the
finish.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: That light had a name—Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The strongest are always those who
believe in themselves and follow
their own
path.

For Winning Ticket, the first race of the
Classics, the Satsuki Sho,
ends in failure.
The day after her defeat...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What was next, incline training?

She's training like any other day, though I
told her it's okay to rest
right after a race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know, I kinda feel like I can't take a
break, even for a day...
Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna get on with incline training!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
She always lets her feelings take the
wheel, so I thought she'd be all
like,
"Nooo, I lost!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But she doesn't seem to have her normal
boundless energy. Losing the
Satsuki Sho
must've been a tremendous shock.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
'Cause it means she could lose the Derby
next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, make sure to keep an eye on her
please.

I say that, but I have no idea what to do
for Winning Ticket right now.

I go back to my office after training to find
her in there.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Did you forget something?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: No, just thought I'd watch a racing video.

She's watching another Derby video. She
comes here to do that
pretty often.

But before, she would always get choked
up and start yelling about
how emotional
it is. This time she's just sitting here quiet
as a mouse.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! O-oh, right... Yeah. I'll be in the
race I've been watching since
forever.

Usually she can't calm down once she
starts talking about the Derby,
but she
seems uneasy about something today.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry we didn't win the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry we didn't win the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer? Can I say something pretty
obvious?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Like what?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In racing, there's times when you lose,
huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but we work hard so that
doesn't happen, right?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but we work hard so that
doesn't happen, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I tried my hardest in the Satsuki
Sho. I did everything I
could have.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Still... it wasn't enough. I feel like I finally
understand how hard racing
really is.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So now the videos I was always so excited
to watch... It's like they've
turned into
something else.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I used to see the racers who lost and get
all worked up like it was
some big theater
performance.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But I had no idea what they were really
feeling. How it felt when their
dreams were
shattered...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh, ha ha... Guess I'm a little on edge!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Welp, I'd better get back soon or the
dorm head will get pretty mad!
See you
tomorrow!

She's gone, and the room falls silent
except for the sound of the
Derby video
still playing.
